page.layout: One printed page. One text column with the running head and page number above it. Margin notes stand in the left margin, beside the paragraphs they belong to (Commemoratio, Præmonitio, Concessio). Catchword "Ejus" at the foot, right.

main_text.p: quis vivâ voce, vel etiam scripto docet practi-ca.
Estq; vel Informatio intellectus, vel Confirmatio voluntatis.
Informatio intellectus est, quâ is informatur tùm præceptis, tùm exemplis practicis[?] ad dexteritatem cùm judicandi, tùm consultan-di.

Hic excellit instituendi consilii γυμνασία[?]. Consilii instituendi γυμνασία[?] est duplex, generalis, & specialis. In genere de consilio & ratione consultandi docet Logica, ut fusè & erudite ostendit Keckerm.in Logic.speciali. In specie autem de consultatione tractat philosophia practica.
Informatio illa est vel Narratio, vel Conces-sio.
Commemoratio est, quâ narratur aliquid esse vel non esse, posse esse vel non posse.
3 Præmoni-tio.Præmonitio est, quâ superior narrat, quid agere vel intermittere possit.

p.i: Hic ab inferioribus requiritur fides, quam narra-tis habere debent.

main_text.p: 4 Concessio.Concessio est, quâ superiores aliquid libe-rum concedunt arbitrio inferiorum.

p.i: Hic inferiores honestè uti debent libertate illâ, dis-cernendo inter res medias, & non-medias.

main_text.p: Confirmatio voluntatis est, quâ voluntas inferiorum confirmatur ad constantiam ur-gendi intellectus consilia.

page.notes: Show-through from the facing page appears faintly at the right edge and in the text (e.g. near "quâ is informatur" and "tùm consultandi"); it is not transcribed. Doubtful readings: "practicis" (partly obscured by show-through), and both Greek words "γυμνασία" (the scan is blurred; the letters are read as best possible). The margin notes are transcribed beside their paragraphs; the margin numerals 2, 3 and 4 are part of the notes as printed.
